faq_subtitle: Direct answers about access, AI, mobile, and data protection.

faqs.q: Can I start as an individual catechist?
faqs.a: Yes. The catechist path shows the personal options to organize your class, with or without AI, before moving to a parish structure.
When you prepare meetings often and want more speed to draft scripts, activities, annual planning, and family messages.
Yes. The platform runs in the mobile browser, including attendance and the main workflows.

faqs.q: Can I import catechumens from my spreadsheet?
faqs.a: Yes. CSV import lets you add catechumens in bulk from the spreadsheet you already use.
The platform includes LGPD-oriented features, digital consent, access control, and data export or deletion requests.

faqs.q: Is there a path for parishes and dioceses?
faqs.a: Yes. The pricing page separates catechist, parish, and diocese paths to reduce confusion and show only the options that fit each context.
